about_the_game:
WELCOME TO VELOCITY ✦ SKATE FAST, KICK ASS The year is 3000. Above the skyline, the elite live in untouchable luxury. Below, the streets are a battleground. The government’s solution? VeloCity... a city-wide bloodsport on skates, where speed, style, and combat meet. If you want to rise up, you’ll have to skate harder, fight smarter, and outshine your competition.

THE COMPETITION Matches are fought across three interconnected districts: The Grindyard, a Concert stage, and a rooftop pool party at the Starlite Hotel. Zones unlock one by one, forcing you to race, fight, and hold your ground the longest. Claim three trophies and you’ll earn the crowned title: The Star of VeloCity.

SKATE LIKE NEVER BEFORE Our double-button system puts you in sync with your skater: press alternating keys (like A then D) to kick each foot, one after the other, building speed just like real skating! Find your flow and you’ll grind, wall-ride, and keep your momentum. Miss the rhythm and you’ll feel it, every push matters. And when you need that quick burst, hit BOOST to rocket into the fight.

TRICKS. COMBAT. STYLE. In the streets of VeloCity, survival demanded spectacle, a new style of fighting grew based on tricking: a fusion of martial arts, gymnastics, and breakdance. With arcade fighter-style inputs, you can unleash combos that flow seamlessly into your skating. Rack up big tricks, smash through enemies, and let your momentum carry you into the next fight

name: VeloCity

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 Version 1703
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 Version 2004
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB VRAM, RTX 3060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Compete in the heart of VeloCity, where skill meets skates hits your face. In this race for dominance, momentum is power, and flair wins fights. Engage in trick-fueled combat to knock out your rivals and take control of the city, one district at a time. Skate fast. Kick ass!
